narrative: During a peaceful protest outside the Delhi Secretariat, Constable Rajesh Kumar (No. 3421/DAP) was recorded shoving a 65-year-old demonstrator to the ground. The victim sustained a fractured hip. The video shows no provocation or warning before the use of force. A complaint was filed at the same station; no FIR has been registered as of the date of entry.
status_detail: Complaint filed at Kashmere Gate PS on 2026-07-16. DDR No. 234/2026. No FIR registered within 72 hours as mandated under Section 154 CrPC.
